title: Synergy of strength–ductility in HfMoTaTiZr refractory high entropy alloy through Cr addition

recollection.structure: Guess: possibly a solid solution or a nanostructured alloy
recollection.mechanism: Guess: possibly grain refinement, precipitation hardening, or alteration of the alloy's electronic structure
recollection.results: Guess: improved strength and ductility due to the synergistic effects of Cr addition

score.note: Correctly identifies Cr addition, but only as stated in the title and without the 4.2 at.% level. It misses the interconnected multicomponent Laves phase, the solid-solution hardening and crack-hindrance mechanisms, and all quantitative results.
